testCase.title: Intermittent enclosed-garage ventilation detector controls

projectContext.project: Enclosed parking garage with an intermittently operated mechanical ventilation system
projectContext.proposedControl: Operate the ventilation system from carbon monoxide detectors only, using a 35 ppm carbon monoxide set point

exactPassages: Where mechanical ventilation systems for enclosed parking garages operate intermittently, such operation shall be automatic by means of carbon monoxide detectors applied in conjunction with nitrogen dioxide detectors.
Such detectors shall be installed in accordance with their manufacturers' instructions.
Such systems shall operate automatically upon detection of a concentration of carbon monoxide of 25 parts per million (ppm) or nitrogen dioxide of 500 parts per billion (ppb).

testCase.question: An enclosed parking garage will use intermittent mechanical ventilation. The proposed controls use carbon monoxide detectors only and start the system at 35 ppm carbon monoxide. Based only on the selected Mechanical Code provision, is that control sequence compliant, and what can and cannot be concluded?
testCase.expectedConclusion: The proposed control sequence does not match MC 404.1. For intermittent operation in an enclosed parking garage, automatic operation must use carbon monoxide detectors in conjunction with nitrogen dioxide detectors. The system must operate automatically when carbon monoxide reaches 25 ppm or nitrogen dioxide reaches 500 ppb, so a carbon-monoxide-only sequence at 35 ppm omits the required nitrogen dioxide detection and exceeds the stated carbon monoxide trigger. The detectors must also be installed according to their manufacturers' instructions. The selected provision does not establish detector quantity or placement, the complete ventilation rate and capacity, or compliance of the rest of the mechanical design.

expectedUncertainty.description: The selected provision resolves the detector types and automatic-operation thresholds, but it does not establish the complete ventilation-system design or detector layout.

answer.answerText:
No. Based on MC 404.1, the proposed sequence is not compliant as described: intermittent operation must be automatic by means of carbon monoxide detectors applied in conjunction with nitrogen dioxide detectors, and the system must operate automatically at either 25 ppm carbon monoxide or 500 ppb nitrogen dioxide. A carbon-monoxide-only sequence omits the required nitrogen-dioxide detectors, and a 35 ppm carbon-monoxide set point is higher than the specified 25 ppm threshold.

MC 404.1 also requires the detectors to be installed in accordance with the manufacturers’ instructions. The selected provision therefore establishes the required detector types, control relationship, trigger concentrations, and installation-instruction condition, but it does not establish that the proposed detector locations, coverage, detector equipment, or complete mechanical-system design comply. Overall project compliance cannot be determined from this provision alone, although the stated CO-only/35-ppm sequence fails the requirements quoted above.
answer.conclusion: No. Based on MC 404.1, the proposed sequence is not compliant as described: intermittent operation must be automatic by means of carbon monoxide detectors applied in conjunction with nitrogen dioxide detectors, and the system must operate automatically at either 25 ppm carbon monoxide or 500 ppb nitrogen dioxide. A carbon-monoxide-only sequence omits the required nitrogen-dioxide detectors, and a 35 ppm carbon-monoxide set point is higher than the specified 25 ppm threshold.
